text: 你挣脱狼群，狼群开始撕扯你那些不幸学生的尸体。趁这残酷的分心时刻，你抢先拉开一段距离，几头捕食者随后脱离狼群追来。你能坚持到它们失去兴趣吗？

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 340
text: You break free of the pack, which tears at the bodies of your hapless students. That grisly diversion allows you to get a good head start before a few of the predators break off to give chase. Can you keep going until they lose interest?
